name: @loom/runbook-recall
description: Knowledge retrieval (RAG) built entirely from primitives loom already ships: a semantic memory tier as the corpus, MemoryStore.search as the retriever, ctx.decide to make the retrieval a recorded fact, and the ADR-0085 taint that refuses a retrieved passage in an instruction position. No knowledge base, no embedding SPI, no framework change. Headless.
